name: Overpressure Blast Effects Analysis Burden Reducing Clarification
effect: Proposes to amend the regulations to state that a far-field overpressure blast effects analysis required for license applicants does not need to account for members of the public in hypothetical locations
alignment_notes: Streamlines launch approvals, but focuses primarily on airspace safety rather than orbital lifecycle tracking or on-orbit maneuver intent
sponsors: Lisa Cacciatore (FAA Office of Commercial Space Transportation)
